market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil >$100, rising yields, and Fed hike uncertainty. Expect volatility into next week's FOMC. Energy and short-duration bonds outperform; equities under pressure. Oil could test $115 if Houthi attacks escalate. 10Y yield may breach 5.2%.
market_outlook.long_term: If oil stabilizes below $95 and Fed pauses after 1-2 hikes, equities recover in H1 2027. AI infrastructure capex cycle supports ORCL/NVDA through 2027. Housing remains suppressed until rates normalize below 6%. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, Gulf strategy) adds 1-2% GDP drag. Private credit fills traditional banking gap structurally.
